seoTitle: Thrive 2027 | A Gathering for Women | Omaha, NE
seoDescription: Thrive is a two-day gathering for women 16 and older at Christ Community Church in Omaha, February 5 and 6, 2027, featuring Bible teacher Lisa Harper. Friday evening and Saturday morning of worship and teaching around the theme Awe and Delight.
shareDescription: February 5 & 6, 2027 in Omaha. Featuring Lisa Harper. For women 16 and older.
eventDescription: A gathering for women ages sixteen and older to grow in community, worship, and connect deeply with God.
